name: NASA POWER: Prediction of Worldwide Energy Resources Daily Meteorology
description: NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources) is an operational data service developed by NASA Langley Research Center that delivers continuous global analysis-ready meteorological and solar parameters for renewable energy, building efficiency, and agroclimatology. Powered by NASA satellite observations and the Goddard Modern-Era Retrospective Analysis for Research and Applications Version 2 (MERRA-2) assimilation model, POWER provides daily gridded (0.5° latitude x 0.625° longitude) variables from 1981 to near real-time, including solar irradiance, temperature, humidity, wind speed, surface pressure, and precipitation via REST API, CSV, and JSON.

license.name: NASA Open Data Policy / Public Domain
